demo.fileOrNotes: File synthetic OR notes to Epic
demo.lead: Fast-forward the clock to show the Outreach Agent's 72 h / 48 h / 24 h steps. All follow-up visits are scheduled at the same time.
demo.orNotesHelp: The sandbox patients have no sternal wire procedure, so a synthetic OR note is written for each. Filing it to Epic (DocumentReference.Create) lets the assistant read it back through FHIR. If Epic refuses, the assistant reads the local copy and says so.
demo.resetConfirm: Reset the demo? This clears answers, photos, assistant results and decisions (the audit log is kept).
demo.signInForNotes: Sign in with Epic to file the OR notes.
demo.step1: Sign in with Epic (sandbox clinician FHIRTWO). Open the worklist: four test patients, names read live from Epic.
demo.step2: Jump to V−72 h: the Outreach Agent sends the MyChart questionnaire to the three patients with MyChart.
demo.step3: Camila completes the check-in on her phone (MyChart sandbox login fhircamila, photo 'Healing well'). Desiree reports drainage (photo 'Redness and drainage').
demo.step4: Jump to V−48 h: Derrick hasn't responded, so he gets a reminder.
demo.step5: Jump to V−24 h: the agent calls Derrick. He agrees to video and shows his incision (retention sutures). Warren (no MyChart) gets a voice call.
demo.step6: Open Camila in the worklist and run the Clinical Decision Assistant: watch the MCP tool calls, then the index and flags.
demo.step7: The APN chooses the follow-up and records it; the note is filed in Epic and the audit trail updates. Contrast with Desiree (red flag) and Derrick (suture options).
demo.title: Demo controls

footer.ai: AI recommends; the APN decides. The Virtual-care Suitability Index is illustrative and has not been validated.
footer.synthetic: Proof of concept for an MHA residency presentation. Synthetic data only: Epic sandbox test patients, invented procedures and computer-generated wound images. Not for clinical use.

home.agent1.body: 72 h before the visit it sends the MyChart questionnaire and photo request, 48 h before it sends a reminder, and within 24 h it calls the patient (video if they agree, otherwise voice) to collect the answers.
home.agent1.title: Outreach Agent
home.agent2.body: Analyses the wound photo and the questionnaire, researches the Epic chart through MCP tools (history, OR note, labs) and calculates the Virtual-care Suitability Index with reasons and flags.
home.agent2.title: Clinical Decision Assistant
home.apnDecides: AI recommends. The APN reviews the evidence and makes every decision.
home.check.mcp.bridge: Built-in read-only Epic FHIR MCP bridge (stand-in for Epic's MCP connectors, announced for Q1 2027)
home.check.redirect: Redirect URI to register in Epic (exact match): {uri}
home.lead: Two AI agents support the ACTU pathway after sternal wire–related procedures: one collects the pre-visit questionnaire and wound photo, the other prepares the evidence for the APN.
home.setupHelp: See README.md for the Epic app registration steps. Keys and client IDs go in .env, never in the code.
home.title: Pre-visit screening for virtual follow-up
